snippet.title: We Gotta Go Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
A co-operative horror game with a turgid twist, We Gotta Go tasks you with finding the key to the bathroom before any unfortunate accidents... a new trailer, aired during the Spring Showcase, provided a closer look at gameplay. We Gotta Go is coming to PC on April 14.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967470/We_Gotta_Go/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
